#!name=Bing首页简化
#!desc=墨鱼手记出品的 Quantumult X 重写 · 来源 墨鱼手记
#!author=@ddgksf2013

[MITM]
hostname = sapphire.api.microsoftapp.net, assets.msn.com, api.msn.com

[Rewrite]
^https?:\/\/assets\.msn\.com\/service\/weather\/locations\/search - reject
^https:\/\/assets\.msn\.com\/service\/news\/feed\/pages\/startmhp - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.msn\.com\/weather - reject

[Script]
http-response ^https?:\/\/sapphire\.api\.microsoftapp\.net\/config\/api\/v1\/get, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/bing.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
